Name: Sundial
Author: BurninWeeknd
Description:
Run out of time on a big farm day? Get a second chance.
Reset the day back to 6:00 AM once per month using a placeable Sundial.
Perfect for large farms, seasonal setup days, or anytime you just need a little more time to finish what you started.
This does not undo actions — it simply resets the time back to 06:00.

A mysterious device that bends time itself... use it wisely.

Unlocked after repairing Willy’s boat. 

Crafting recipe is as follows:
     - 25 Iridium bars
     - 10 Battery packs
     - 1 Prismatic Shard
     - 200 Hardwood
     - 10 Dragon teeth
